summary: One record per constant-dosing interval of protocol-specified treatment per subject, in protocol units. EX drives DM.RFXSTDTC and RFXENDTC, so map it before finishing DM.

EXTRT.tip: The protocol name of the treatment, e.g. "DRUG A" or "PLACEBO". Blinded studies still use the actual treatment name in SDTM.

EXDOSE.tip: Dose per administration in protocol units, as a number. Placebo usually gets 0 or the matching dose amount, as your protocol defines.

EXDOSU.tip: Units of EXDOSE from the UNIT codelist.

EXSTDTC.tip: Start of the dosing interval. The earliest EXSTDTC per subject becomes DM.RFXSTDTC.

EXENDTC.tip: End of the dosing interval. The latest EXENDTC per subject becomes DM.RFXENDTC.

EXADJ.tip: Reason for a dose adjustment, if collected.
